title: BEACH Parameter File
description: Grouped BEACH input (run/domain/mesh/particles/fields/sheath/output). Runtime preflight additionally checks physical combinations.

mode.description: Field boundary closure. periodic2 normally requires field_solver=fmm; the direct triangle_p0 panel_spectral_reference split model is the validation-only exception.

electron_species.description: Ambient-electron role. Matching requires volume_seed with npcls_per_step=0 and only z-high boundary_inflow=reservoir.

ion_species.description: Ambient-ion role. Matching requires volume_seed with npcls_per_step=0 and only z-high boundary_inflow=reservoir.

reference_area_m2.description: Zhao effective z-normal collection area [m^2]. Defaults to the domain x-y area.

outflow_refresh_batches.description: Zhao stationary only. Re-solve the outer zero-current root every N accepted batches from the photoelectron outflow observed at the z-high matching plane. 0 keeps the initial root.

zhao_upstream_band_tolerance.description: Accepted width of negative E^2 next to upstream for Zhao A/C roots with inward electron drift, as a fraction of |phi_m| (A) or |phi_0| (C). 0 keeps the exact semi-infinite condition.

zhao_upstream_field_floor_v_m.description: External field level [V/m] at which the outer sheath hands over to the upstream plasma. Drifting Zhao A/C roots are accepted when the field deficit sqrt(-min E^2) inside the upstream band does not exceed it; the solar-wind motional field |u x B| is the natural scale. 0 disables this criterion.

zhao_ion_pressure_factor.description: Pressure coefficient of the warm-ion fluid in the Zhao root (Sana & Mishra 2026): 1 isothermal, 3 adiabatic one-dimensional. The ion temperature is the ion species temperature; the entry must stay supersonic, m_i u^2/e > factor*T_i.

include_reflected_electrons.description: Zhao stationary only, with outflow_refresh_batches > 0. Add ambient electrons that reflect inside the cell and leave through the z-high matching plane to the outer emitted source; the closure credits their tracked escape to the electron absorbed target and subtracts it from the emitted-electron targets. Without photoelectrons and secondary electrons the reflected electrons are the whole outer source and the electron targets are pinned to the root.

positiveVec2.description: 2-component vector [x, y] with all positive values.

positiveVec3.description: 3-component vector [x, y, z] with all positive values.

sizeFraction.description: Box-relative template size. Shape depends on template kind.

placementMode.description: High-level placement mode normalized by the Fortran config loader.

surfaceSide.description: Physical vacuum side relative to ordered triangle winding.

scaleReference.description: Box dimension used as a high-level mesh group scale reference.

particleBoundaryAction.description: Tracked-particle action on a nonperiodic face. reflect reverses only the normal velocity. redistributed_reflect additionally resamples the tangential position uniformly on the face while preserving tangential velocity.

speciesParticleBoundary.description: Per-species overrides of global particle-boundary actions.

speciesParticleBoundaryAction.description: Per-species action; inherit uses the global particle boundary. redistributed_reflect is a normal-velocity reflection with uniform tangential-position redistribution.

speciesBoundaryInflow.description: Per-species reservoir inflow attached to complete nonperiodic box faces.

injectFace.description: Box face identifier for particle injection.

batch_duration.description: Batch duration [s]. Mutually exclusive with batch_duration_step.

substep_field_change_max.description: Adaptive sub-steps: halve a step whose midpoint field changes by more than this fraction from the last accepted midpoint field (and whose change times the displacement exceeds 1e-4 eV). 0 disables.

substep_max_halvings.description: Maximum number of halvings of one time step (smallest sub-step dt/2^n).

tol_rel.description: Monitoring metric; not an early-stop condition.

e0.description: Uniform external electric field vector [V/m]. Mutually exclusive with e0_abs/e0_phi_*.

e0_abs.description: Magnitude of the uniform external electric field [V/m].

e0_phi_xy_deg.description: Azimuth angle of e0 in the x-y plane [deg]. Requires e0_abs.

e0_phi_z_deg.description: Elevation angle of e0 from the x-y plane [deg]. Requires e0_abs.

field_normalization.description: Length normalization used internally by field solvers.

field_periodic_image_layers.description: Nearby image layers for periodic2. Computes [-N, N] finite image sum per periodic axis.

field_periodic_far_correction.description: Far-field correction mode for periodic2. cached_kneq0 reuses a versioned nonzero-mode operator.

field_periodic_ewald_alpha.description: Ewald splitting parameter for cached_kneq0 operator generation. 0 = auto-determined from box size.

field_periodic_ewald_layers.description: Ewald real-space/reciprocal shell depth for cached_kneq0 operator generation.

field_periodic_cache_dir.description: Directory for versioned cached_kneq0 operators. If omitted: BEACH_CACHE_DIR/periodic2, else XDG_CACHE_HOME/beach/periodic2, else HOME/.cache/beach/periodic2. Explicit paths take precedence.

field_periodic_generation_tolerance.description: Generation tolerance included in the periodic operator cache identity.

tree_theta.description: Optional explicit MAC parameter for treecode/FMM (0 < theta <= 1). When omitted, BEACH selects it from the element-count heuristic.

tree_leaf_max.description: Optional explicit maximum elements per leaf node in treecode/FMM. When omitted, BEACH selects it from the element-count heuristic.

tree_min_nelem.description: Element count threshold for field_solver=auto to switch from direct evaluation to FMM.

multiple_box_events_policy.description: Action when one particle step exceeds the internal box-boundary event limit. soft_discard records and removes only that particle.

multiple_box_events_retry_backend.description: Optional retry used only after multiple_box_events. upper_panel_fourier replays the step with a factorized P0-panel Fourier field and potential when every electrostatic sample lies above the geometry.

multiple_box_events_soft_discard_count_g.description: Cumulative soft-discard count tolerated before the fraction-based stop limit is enforced.

multiple_box_events_soft_discard_fractio.description: Maximum cumulative soft-discard fraction of processed particles after the count grace.

multiple_box_events_soft_discard_abs_cha.description: Cumulative absolute macro-particle charge [C] whose first threshold crossing emits a warning.

raycast_max_bounce.description: Maximum bounce count for photo_raycast ray tracing.

species.description: List of particle species (at least one required).

species_key.description: Stable unique species identifier used by surface-current model references; defaults to species_<1-based index>.

npcls_per_step.description: Macro-particles generated per batch for volume_seed.

target_macro_particles_per_batch.description: For flux-driven reservoir injection, either the total macro-particle target across all enabled inflow faces or a plane source, or -1 to reuse species[1] weight.

rays_per_batch.description: Ray count per batch for photo_raycast.

deposit_opposite_charge_on_emit.description: Deposit opposite-sign charge on emitting element for photo_raycast.

normal_drift_speed.description: Surface-normal drift speed [m/s] for photo_raycast emission.

ray_direction.description: Ray direction vector for photo_raycast. Defaults to inward face normal.

boundary.description: Optional per-species overrides for all six nonperiodic faces.

boundary_inflow.description: Reservoir inflow attached to full nonperiodic simulation-boundary faces.

surface_charge_closure.description: Surface-charge treatment for this species. fixed_current requires a positive resolved sim.batch_duration, rescales absorbed and emission-reaction channels independently to signed target currents, and fails on an empty nonzero-target channel, but does not impose a statistical minimum sample count or maximum scale; neutral_return closes negative photoelectron emission plus return to zero net surface charge.

target_absorbed_current_a.description: Signed target surface current [A] for the absorbed-particle deposit channel. Its sign must match q_particle.

target_emission_current_a.description: Signed target surface current [A] for the photoemission reaction-charge channel. Its sign must oppose q_particle.

inject_region_mode.description: High-level injection-region mode. face_fraction resolves uv_low/uv_high into pos_low/pos_high.

uv_low.description: Lower [u, v] range on inject_face for inject_region_mode="face_fraction".

uv_high.description: Upper [u, v] range on inject_face for inject_region_mode="face_fraction".

parts.description: Ordered OBJ and template parts; enabled parts receive consecutive mesh_id values starting at 1.

groups.description: High-level named mesh groups that provide a common origin and scale for templates.

offset.description: Offset [m] added to the group origin.

offset_frac.description: Box-size-relative offset added to the group origin.

scale.description: Absolute group scale factor for local template coordinates and lengths.

scale_from.description: Box dimension used with scale_factor to compute group scale.

write_mesh_potential.description: Output element centroid potentials to mesh_potential.csv.

write_potential_history.description: Output element centroid potential snapshots to potential_history.csv at history_stride intervals.

checkpoint_stride.description: Output interval for restart checkpoints [accepted batches]. 0 disables periodic checkpoints; final output remains restartable.

restart_from.description: Checkpoint input directory used when resume=true. New outputs are still written to output.dir.

substep_field_change_max.description: Adaptive sub-steps: halve a step whose midpoint field changes by more than this fraction from the last accepted midpoint field (and whose change times the displacement exceeds 1e-4 eV). 0 disables.

substep_max_halvings.description: Maximum number of halvings of one time step (smallest sub-step dt/2^n).

policy.description: Action when one particle step exceeds the internal box-boundary event limit. soft_discard records and removes only that particle.

retry_backend.description: Optional retry used only after multiple_box_events. upper_panel_fourier replays the step with a factorized P0-panel Fourier field and potential when every electrostatic sample lies above the geometry.

discard_count_grace.description: Cumulative soft-discard count tolerated before the fraction-based stop limit is enforced.

discard_fraction_limit.description: Maximum cumulative soft-discard fraction of processed particles after the count grace.

discard_charge_warning_c.description: Cumulative absolute macro-particle charge [C] whose first threshold crossing emits a warning.

max_bounces.description: Maximum bounce count for photo_raycast ray tracing.

species.description: List of particle species (at least one required).

particles.description: Boundary actions, reservoir, tracking, species and sampling.

duration_s.description: Batch duration [s]. Mutually exclusive with batch_duration_step.

max_nonzero_mode_potential_step_v.description: Maximum accepted change of the cached k!=0 potential at panel centroids [V]. When set, batch_duration is the maximum trial duration and rejected trials are retraced at successive factors of 1/2.

from.description: Checkpoint input directory used when resume=true. New outputs are still written to output.dir.

restart.description: Presence resumes from a checkpoint. Omit from to search output.dir.

run.description: Batch clock, stopping target, random seed, and restart.

charge_rel_change_threshold.description: Monitoring metric; not an early-stop condition.

mesh_potential.description: Output element centroid potentials to mesh_potential.csv.

potential.description: Output element centroid potential snapshots to potential_history.csv at history_stride intervals.

stride_batches.description: Output interval for restart checkpoints [accepted batches]. 0 disables periodic checkpoints; final output remains restartable.

normalization.description: Length normalization used internally by field solvers.

theta.description: Optional explicit MAC parameter for treecode/FMM (0 < theta <= 1). When omitted, BEACH selects it from the element-count heuristic.

leaf_max.description: Optional explicit maximum elements per leaf node in treecode/FMM. When omitted, BEACH selects it from the element-count heuristic.

auto_fmm_min_elements.description: Element count threshold for field_solver=auto to switch from direct evaluation to FMM.

image_layers.description: Nearby image layers for periodic2. Computes [-N, N] finite image sum per periodic axis.

backend.description: One owner of periodic field backend selection; split backends derive exclude_k0.

ewald_alpha.description: Ewald splitting parameter for cached_kneq0 operator generation. 0 = auto-determined from box size.

ewald_layers.description: Ewald real-space/reciprocal shell depth for cached_kneq0 operator generation.

cache_dir.description: Directory for versioned cached_kneq0 operators. If omitted: BEACH_CACHE_DIR/periodic2, else XDG_CACHE_HOME/beach/periodic2, else HOME/.cache/beach/periodic2. Explicit paths take precedence.

generation_tolerance.description: Generation tolerance included in the periodic operator cache identity.

electric_v_m.description: Uniform external electric field vector [V/m]. Mutually exclusive with e0_abs/e0_phi_*.

electric_magnitude_v_m.description: Magnitude of the uniform external electric field [V/m].

electric_azimuth_deg.description: Azimuth angle of e0 in the x-y plane [deg]. Requires e0_abs.

electric_elevation_deg.description: Elevation angle of e0 from the x-y plane [deg]. Requires e0_abs.

deposit_opposite_charge_on_emit.description: Deposit opposite-sign charge on emitting element for photo_raycast.

normal_drift_speed_m_s.description: Surface-normal drift speed [m/s] for photo_raycast emission.

volume_macro_particles_per_batch.description: Macro-particles generated per batch for volume_seed.

kind.description: OBJ input or procedural shape kind.

surface_model.description: Surface response for this part. Each enabled part is one mesh_id and one floating conductor group.

surface_side.description: Vacuum side for this template. Required when enabled by the implicit triangle_p0 panel kernel.

cap.description: Enable both end caps for cylinder.

cap_top.description: Enable top end cap for cylinder (overrides cap).

cap_bottom.description: Enable bottom end cap for cylinder (overrides cap).

offset.description: OBJ translation [m], or offset of an anchored template center.

offset_frac.description: Box-size-relative offset added to the anchored template center.

group.description: High-level mesh group name. Grouped templates use center_local and group scale/origin.

scale.description: OBJ読み込み後に適用する一様スケーリング係数

rotation.description: OBJ読み込み後に適用する回転角 [度]。x→y→z 外因性回転 (Rz·Ry·Rx)
